    Pathum Thani Province, Thailand. This script applies a wider horizontal

    Khlong Nueng is a narrow (~15 m wide) channel whose Landsat 30 m pixels
    extend substantially into adjacent agricultural land; additional lateral
    context reduces visual distortion and aids compliance interpretation.

## 2  Khlong Nueng Map Creation Function

`create_khlong_nueng_map()` wraps the core map assembly with parameters
tuned specifically for the narrow Khlong Nueng canal geometry:

- **Wider x-buffer** (3.0×): compensates for the narrow E-W footprint and
  ensures meaningful lateral basemap context appears on either side of the canal.
- **Taller y-buffer** (1.2×): preserves N-S context for the elongated canal reach.
- **Smaller north arrow** (0.7–1.5 cm, scaled dynamically): avoids overlap with
  the narrow data stripe.
- **Legend position** shifted left to prevent occlusion of the narrow canal stripe.

```{r khlong_nueng_map_function}
#' Create a publication-quality WQ map for Khlong Nueng canal.
#'
#' Applies narrow-canal-specific buffer and legend settings on top of the
#' standard map assembly. Input files must match the Khlong Nueng naming
#' convention (parsed via \code{parse_khlong_filename()}).
#'
#' @param raster_data  Named list with elements \code{raster} (SpatRaster),
#'   \code{info} (output of \code{parse_khlong_filename()}), and
#'   \code{file_path} (character).
#' @param parameter_name Character. WQ parameter label.
#' @param unit      Character. Unit string for the colour-bar legend.
#' @param min_val   Numeric. Lower clamp value for the colour ramp.
#' @param max_val   Numeric. Upper clamp value for the colour ramp.
#' @param color_palette Character vector of colour stops.
#' @param reverse_colors Logical. Reverse the palette. Default FALSE.
#' @param verbose   Logical. Print diagnostics. Default FALSE.
#' @return A ggplot object, or NULL on failure.
create_khlong_nueng_map <- function(raster_data,
                                    parameter_name,
                                    unit,
                                    min_val,
                                    max_val,
                                    color_palette  = c("blue","cyan","green",
                                                       "yellow","orange","red",
                                                       "magenta"),
                                    reverse_colors = FALSE,
                                    verbose        = FALSE) {

  # ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(raster_data) ||
      !inherits(raster_data$raster, "SpatRaster")) {
    message(parameter_name, ": invalid raster_data supplied — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (!grepl("Khlong_Nueng", raster_data$info$water_body, fixed = TRUE)) {
    warning("create_khlong_nueng_map: file does not appear to be from Khlong Nueng.")
  }

  raster_df <- as.data.frame(raster_data$raster, xy = TRUE) |> stats::na.omit()
  if (nrow(raster_df) == 0L) {
    message(parameter_name, ": raster is entirely NA — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  names(raster_df)[3L] <- parameter_name

  # ── Spatial geometry ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  shape_info <- analyze_raster_shape(raster_data$raster)
  if (is.na(shape_info$width) || shape_info$width <= 0) {
    message(parameter_name, ": invalid raster dimensions — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("Khlong Nueng %s: %d data points; aspect ratio %.2f\n",
                parameter_name, nrow(raster_df), shape_info$aspect_ratio))
  }

  x_range <- range(raster_df$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- range(raster_df$y, na.rm = TRUE)
  dw      <- x_range[2L] - x_range[1L]
  dh      <- y_range[2L] - y_range[1L]

  # Narrow-canal buffer: large x-multiplier to add lateral context
  buf    <- 0.2
  xm     <- 3.0
  ym     <- 1.2

  xmin_buf <- x_range[1L] - buf * xm * dw
  xmax_buf <- x_range[2L] + buf * xm * dw
  ymin_buf <- y_range[1L] - buf * ym * dh
  ymax_buf <- y_range[2L] + buf * ym * dh

  if (xmin_buf >= xmax_buf || ymin_buf >= ymax_buf) {
    message(parameter_name, ": bounding box collapsed after buffering — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ── CRS and bounding box ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  crs_str  <- tryCatch(terra::crs(raster_data$raster), error = function(e) "")
  safe_crs <- tryCatch(
    sf::st_crs(if (nchar(crs_str) > 0L) crs_str else "EPSG:4326"),
    error = function(e) sf::st_crs(4326L)
  )

  bbox     <- sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = xmin_buf, ymin = ymin_buf,
                             xmax = xmax_buf, ymax = ymax_buf),
                           crs = safe_crs)
  bbox_sfc <- tryCatch(sf::st_as_sfc(bbox), error = function(e) NULL)

  # ── Basemap tiles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tiles <- fetch_basemap_tiles(bbox_sfc)

  # ── Colour ramp ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ramp <- colorRampPalette(color_palette)(100L)
  if (reverse_colors) ramp <- rev(ramp)

  # ── Dynamic north-arrow size (proportional to visible diagonal) ─────────────
  diag_visible <- sqrt((xmax_buf - xmin_buf)^2 + (ymax_buf - ymin_buf)^2)
  arrow_cm     <- max(0.7, min(1.5, diag_visible * 5e-5))

  # ── Title and subtitle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  subtitle_text <- if (parameter_name == "pH") {
    paste0("pH \u2014 ", raster_data$info$date_string)
  } else {
    unit_str <- trimws(unit)
    if (nchar(unit_str) > 0L) {
      paste0(parameter_name, " (", unit_str, ") \u2014 ",
             raster_data$info$date_string)
    } else {
      paste0(parameter_name, " \u2014 ", raster_data$info$date_string)
    }
  }

  # ── ggplot assembly ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  map <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    { if (!is.null(tiles))
        tidyterra::geom_spatraster_rgb(data = tiles, alpha = 0.95)
      else
        ggplot2::theme(
          panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey92")
        )
    } +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(
      data = raster_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, fill = !!rlang::sym(parameter_name)),
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors  = ramp,
      limits  = c(min_val, max_val),
      oob     = scales::squish,
      name    = NULL,
      breaks  = c(min_val, max_val),
      labels  = c(paste("Low:", min_val), paste("High:", max_val)),
      guide   = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
        direction      = "vertical",
        barheight      = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "cm"),
        barwidth       = ggplot2::unit(0.3, "cm"),
        label.position = "left",
        label.hjust    = 1,
        ticks          = TRUE,
        nbin           = 10L
      )
    ) +
    ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
      location    = "tr",
      which_north = "grid",
      pad_x  = ggplot2::unit(0.5, "cm"),
      pad_y  = ggplot2::unit(0.5, "cm"),
      style  = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
        fill     = c("white","black"),
        line_col = "black",
        text_col = "black"
      ),
      height = ggplot2::unit(arrow_cm, "cm"),
      width  = ggplot2::unit(arrow_cm, "cm")
    ) +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(
      location      = "br",
      width_hint    = 0.20,
      style         = "bar",
      text_cex      = 0.9,
      line_width    = 0.8,
      pad_x         = ggplot2::unit(0.4, "cm"),
      pad_y         = ggplot2::unit(0.15, "cm"),
      bar_cols      = c("black","white"),
      unit_category = "metric"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = "**Khlong Nueng**",
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_sf(
      xlim   = c(xmin_buf, xmax_buf),
      ylim   = c(ymin_buf, ymax_buf),
      expand = FALSE,
      crs    = safe_crs
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text         = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title        = ggtext::element_markdown(
                            size = 17, hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)
                          ),
      plot.subtitle     = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14),
      # Legend shifted leftward to avoid overlapping the narrow canal stripe
      legend.position   = c(-10.2, 2.0),
      legend.justification = c(0.85, 0.5),
      legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(
                            fill  = scales::alpha("white", 0.7),
                            color = NA
                          ),
      legend.key.height = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width  = ggplot2::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.margin     = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
      plot.margin       = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA),
      panel.border      = ggplot2::element_rect(
                            color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5
                          )
    )

  map
}
```

## 3  Workflow Functions

### 3.1  Preview a single Khlong Nueng file

```{r single_file_preview_function}
#' Load and render one Khlong Nueng GeoTIFF as a WQ map.
#'
#' @param parameter_name Character. One of the names in \code{param_settings}.
#' @param file_index     Integer. Position in the sorted file list. Default 1.
#' @param verbose        Logical. Print file list and diagnostics. Default TRUE.
#' @return A ggplot object, or NULL.
preview_khlong_parameter <- function(parameter_name, file_index = 1L,
                                      verbose = TRUE) {
  s <- param_settings[[parameter_name]]
  if (is.null(s)) {
    message("preview_khlong_parameter: '", parameter_name, "' not in settings.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Filter to Khlong Nueng files only
  files <- list_available_files(parameter_name, s,
                                 water_body = "Khlong_Nueng",
                                 verbose = verbose)
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(NULL)

  fi <- max(1L, min(file_index, length(files)))
  if (fi != file_index)
    message("File index adjusted to ", fi, " (valid range 1–", length(files), ").")

  rinfo <- parse_khlong_filename(files[fi])
  if (is.null(rinfo)) return(NULL)

  r <- tryCatch(terra::rast(files[fi]), error = function(e) {
    message("Error loading raster: ", e$message); NULL
  })
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)

  rdata <- list(raster = r, info = rinfo, file_path = files[fi])

  create_khlong_nueng_map(
    raster_data    = rdata,
    parameter_name = parameter_name,
    unit           = s$unit,
    min_val        = s$min_val,
    max_val        = s$max_val,
    color_palette  = s$color_palette,
    reverse_colors = s$reverse_colors,
    verbose        = verbose
  )
}
```

### 3.2  Batch-render all Khlong Nueng files for a parameter

```{r batch_render_function}
#' Render and optionally save all Khlong Nueng maps for one parameter.
#'
#' @param parameter_name Character. Parameter to process.
#' @param save_maps      Logical. Save PNG/PDF files to disk. Default FALSE.
#' @param verbose        Logical. Print per-file progress. Default TRUE.
#' @return Named list of ggplot objects (invisibly).
batch_render_khlong_parameter <- function(parameter_name, save_maps = FALSE,
                                           verbose = TRUE) {
  s <- param_settings[[parameter_name]]
  if (is.null(s)) {
    message("batch_render_khlong_parameter: '", parameter_name, "' not in settings.")
    return(invisible(list()))
  }

  files <- list_available_files(parameter_name, s,
                                 water_body = "Khlong_Nueng",
                                 verbose = verbose)
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(invisible(list()))

  message("\nProcessing ", length(files), " Khlong Nueng file(s) for [",
          parameter_name, "]...")

  map_list <- list()

  for (fp in files) {
    rinfo <- parse_khlong_filename(fp)
    if (is.null(rinfo)) next

    r <- tryCatch(terra::rast(fp), error = function(e) {
      message("Error loading: ", basename(fp), " — ", e$message); NULL
    })
    if (is.null(r)) next

    rdata <- list(raster = r, info = rinfo, file_path = fp)

    map <- create_khlong_nueng_map(
      raster_data    = rdata,
      parameter_name = parameter_name,
      unit           = s$unit,
      min_val        = s$min_val,
      max_val        = s$max_val,
      color_palette  = s$color_palette,
      reverse_colors = s$reverse_colors,
      verbose        = verbose
    )

    if (!is.null(map)) {
      key <- paste("Khlong_Nueng", parameter_name, rinfo$month_name,
                   rinfo$year, sep = "_")
      map_list[[key]] <- map
      print(map)

      if (save_maps) {
        save_wq_map(
          map        = map,
          output_dir = s$output_dir,
          water_body = "Khlong_Nueng",
          parameter  = parameter_name,
          month_abbr = rinfo$month_abbr,
          year       = rinfo$year
        )
      }
    }
  }

  message("Finished [", parameter_name, "]: ", length(map_list),
          " Khlong Nueng map(s) rendered.\n")
  invisible(map_list)
}
```
